Relative to the card's baseline (logreg + median impute + standard scale, default cut): family changes from linear to gbdt (hist_gbdt, 400 boosting rounds, 31 leaves), the imbalance lever is engaged via class_weight='balanced' instead of the unweighted default, scaling is dropped as unnecessary for trees, and imputation is set to 'none' so the estimator handles any NaN itself.",
  "rationale": "The goal bar of 0.8811 sits above the baseline's own ranking ceiling (balanced_accuracy_at_best_cut 0.8382, KS 0.6765), so no choice of operating point on the logistic ranking can reach it — the required KS is 0.7622, i.e. the ranking must improve by ~0.086. That is a family<path> problem, and the only lever available here is the family, since the executor derives no features. Bank-marketing is a classic tabular mix of 7 numeric and 44 one-hot columns with strongly non-linear, threshold-like structure in V12 (strong target_corr, high skew, 7% outliers) and V6<path> (weak individually, high skew); a linear model on standardised columns cannot express those interactions, while a boosted tree ensemble can — it is the strongest default for this shape of data and the most likely single family to move KS materially. 27k training rows with ~51 encoded columns is comfortably inside the memory and 600 s budgets at 400 iterations, so I turn early stopping off to keep all training rows in the fit and rely on learning_rate 0.06 with l2_regularization 1.0 and 31 leaves to control variance. class_weight='balanced' (ratio pinned at 7.55) is included because the baseline's default cut produced recall 0.345 against precision 0.652 — a heavily specificity-favouring operating point — and balanced_accuracy is the mean of recall and specificity, so the cut must move outward regardless of how good the ranking gets. Pairing the family swap with the weight in one attempt is deliberate but diagnosable: cut_headroom and balanced_accuracy_at_best_cut will separate the ranking gain from the operating-point gain, so attempt 2 can spend itself on whichever axis is still short (more capacity / xgboost for ranking, or an explicit weight map such as {\"0\":1,\"1\":12} for the cut). No missingness columns are requested: overall missing rate is 0.0, the 'unknown' text markers in V4<path> already survive as one-hot levels the tree can split on directly, and the indicator would be redundant under impute='none' anyway.",

  ],
